reason: a workflow can partially fail or retry tool, network, or external operations
guidance: Classify transient, permanent, cancelled and unknown-success outcomes; preserve the original
cause. A timeout does not prove a side effect failed: inspect or reconcile state before replay
unless the operation is idempotent. Bound outbound waits and total retry time, use backoff, and
avoid retries multiplied across layers. Keep partial work resumable or provide rollback/repair;
never convert an unknown or partial outcome into success.
